messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: KV cache eviction rate > 2500/s for shard group us-west-2-a. Continuous-batching inflight tokens spiked 6x. Auto-threshold triggered. Pager: eng-oncall.
Priya (oncall): saw it, I'm on it. impact? any customer-facing 5xxs?
Tom (eng-runtime): perf cliff on sequences ~1k-2k. We see KV page churn + batch window growth. Some requests time out at the serving layer. No global 5xx flood yet but elevated latencies and a few retries.
Priya (oncall): copying graphs... /zoom in on kv.evictions, batch.window_ms, lambda_queue_len.
Ops-bot: alert link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/alerts/2950001234
Tom (eng-runtime): hypothesis: a recent change to batching heuristics increased max_batch_window to 200ms. Causes more aggregator coalescing, KV hotset amplification.
Priya (oncall): ok. can we flip the batching policy back to conservative quickly? do we have a runtime flag?
Tom (eng-runtime): yes — feature flag: runtime.batch_policy=aggressive|conservative. we can flip per-region. I'll prepare a targeted override for us-west-2-a.
Tom (eng-runtime): command I'll run: ```
# per-region override
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  https://admin.redwood/internal/flags/runtime.batch_policy 
  -d '{"region":"us-west-2-a","value":"conservative","reason":"kv-eviction-surge-mitigation"}'
```
Priya (oncall): go for it. make it a phased canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%). add toggles for tenants if needed.
Deploy-bot: FLAG CHANGE REQUESTED by Tom (eng-runtime). change_id=fc-2026-03-15-01. Canary targets: 5% nodes in us-west-2-a.
Tom (eng-runtime): applying canary now. monitoring kv.evictions, batch.window_ms, tail-latency p50/p95.
Priya (oncall): paging customers? any tenants showing errors?
Kate (cust-succ): I see elevated error rates for tenant "mosaic-ai" and a handful of conversational demo accounts. No major enterprise SLA violations reported yet. Mosaic has some timeouts on long-seqlen requests.
Tom (eng-runtime): can do tenant-level override. snippet: ```
# per-tenant override
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/internal/flags/runtime.batch_policy \
  -d '{"tenant":"mosaic-ai","value":"conservative","region":"us-west-2-a"}'
```
Priya (oncall): let's apply tenant override for mosaic-ai while canary runs. Kate, can you DM mosaic-ai with a heads up that we're mitigating and will follow up with RCA? keep it short.
Kate (cust-succ): on it.
Deploy-bot: CANARY PROGRESS: 5% -> 5% (stable 30s). metrics: kv.evictions -12%, batch.window_ms - immediate drop to baseline, tail-latency p95 -8%.
Jai (sre-lead): good signal. watch for re-amplification when we increase to 25%. If eviction rate dips and stays, we can continue rollout. If it flaps, prepare rollback path and fallback routing to older model variants.
Tom (eng-runtime): rolling to 25% now.
Deploy-bot: CANARY PROGRESS: 25% -> stable. metrics: kv.evictions -18%, downstream retries reduced. no increase in errors.
Priya (oncall): I'm updating the incident channel and notes. initial mitigation: revert runtime.batch_policy to conservative in us-west-2-a, tenant override mosaic-ai.
Priya (oncall): note for runbook: if re-amplify, set kv.prefetch_limit=100 for affected shards and open a paging to eng-sre.
Ops-bot: runbook link: https://playbooks.redwood/internal/kv-batch-mitigations#prefetch
Kate (cust-succ): mosaic-ai replied: appreciates quick action, asked for ETA for full fix. I'll tell them we're stabilizing now and will provide follow-up postmortem within 48h.
Tom (eng-runtime): digging into root cause now. suspect regression from commit 4f3b2a: adjust-batching-heuristic. It changed evict heuristics under tail traffic.
Jai (sre-lead): capture heap/kv-metrics snapshot and attach logs from those nodes. request: preserve logs for 72h and don't autoscale them away.
Priya (oncall): done — set retention override on the 12 affected instances. command: `opsctl retention set --nodes node-112,node-115 --hours 72`
Alyssa (next-oncall): I'll take the handoff in 30m. summary pls.
Priya (oncall): handoff summary: incident started at 2950001234. symptom: kv cache eviction surge + batch-window inflation causing tail latency on long sequences. mitigation: runtime.batch_policy set to conservative in us-west-2-a (canary 5->25->100%), tenant-level override for mosaic-ai. current status: metrics trending back to baseline, no SLA breach flagged. artifacts: change_id=fc-2026-03-15-01, logs preserved. next steps: roll to 100% if stable for 15m, otherwise rollback and enable kv.prefetch_limit. escalation: Jai (sre-lead) if re-amplify.
Alyssa (next-oncall): ack — I'll watch the dashboard and take the 10:30 handoff. please post the RCA draft link when available.
Priya (oncall): adding claim:incident for follow-up and RCA owner. Jai, can you own postmortem with Tom?
Jai (sre-lead): yes, I'll pair with Tom on RCA. preliminary blurb: batching heuristic change increases KV hotset residency; fix options: revert heuristic or add adaptive prefetch and tenant-aware caps.
Priya (oncall): closing light: monitoring for 20m before full rollout. I'll update channels and then reassign to Alyssa. thanks all. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied. status: stabilizing. next update in 20m or on state change.
